regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: This combination is used for RAS wild-type bowel cancer that has spread. Your team explains the aim, alternatives and how benefit will be reviewed.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Cetuximab attaches to EGFR on the outside of cells and blocks growth messages. In bowel cancer, a validated RAS wild-type result helps identify whether this approach is suitable. In head-and-neck cancer, weekly cetuximab may be combined with radiotherapy under a separate treatment plan. Healthy skin also uses EGFR, so skin and nail effects need early care. The body converts irinotecan into SN-38. This traps an enzyme called topoisomerase I while DNA is being copied, causing damage that can stop cancer cells dividing. Normal bowel and blood-forming cells can also be affected. Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.
regimen_profiles.schedule_context: Cetuximab on Day 1 and Day 8. Day 1: irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, then a 46-hour fluorouracil pump; planned disconnection around Day 3. A repeating 14-day cycle. The number of cycles depends on benefit, side effects and your treatment plan.
key_points: Cetuximab on Day 1 and Day 8. Day 1: irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil, then a 46-hour fluorouracil pump; planned disconnection around Day 3. A repeating 14-day cycle. The number of cycles depends on benefit, side effects and your treatment plan.

regimen_profiles.clinical_summary: This combination is used for RAS wild-type bowel cancer that has spread. Your team explains the aim, alternatives and how benefit will be reviewed.
regimen_profiles.component_rationale: Cetuximab attaches to EGFR on the outside of cells and blocks growth messages. In bowel cancer, a validated RAS wild-type result helps identify whether this approach is suitable. In head-and-neck cancer, weekly cetuximab may be combined with radiotherapy under a separate treatment plan. Healthy skin also uses EGFR, so skin and nail effects need early care. Oxaliplatin makes links within DNA. These interfere with copying and repair, which can stop a cancer cell dividing. Healthy tissues can also be affected. Folinic acid helps fluorouracil remain bound to an enzyme needed to make DNA. In this regimen it increases fluorouracil activity and can also increase its unwanted effects. It is not a vitamin supplement to start yourself. Fluorouracil interferes with the production and use of DNA and RNA, the instructions cells need to grow. The infusion extends exposure over approximately two days.

drug_profiles.name: Cetuximab
drug_profiles.mechanism: Chimeric IgG1 antibody binding extracellular EGFR and reducing receptor signalling. Extended RAS wild-type selection applies to colorectal indications. Weekly cetuximab with head-and-neck radiotherapy is a separate indication. EGFR activity in healthy tissues contributes to skin and nail toxicity.
